description: This file provides utility functions for spatial data interpolation and bounds calculation, specifically implementing inverse distance weighting (IDW) interpolation on scattered 2D points, computing bounds for a set of points, and clamping Z-values within a specified range.

methods.name: idwInterpolate2D(points, gridSize, bounds, power = 2)
methods.description: Performs inverse distance weighting interpolation on a set of scattered 2D points onto a regular grid, returning grid coordinates and interpolated Z-values.

methods.name: computeBounds(points, padding = 0.05)
methods.description: Calculates spatial bounds (min and max of x and y) from a set of points, with optional padding.

methods.name: clampZByRange(Z, minVal, maxVal)
methods.description: Clamps Z-values in a 2D array to a specified minimum and maximum range.
